text: BAM share rose 0.3 percentage points over 22 hours and 0.48 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.9% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 27% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes should be read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
